texts.preamble: L. Kumar vs State Of Telangana, on 20 March, 2024 The Honourable Smt. Justice K. Sujana Criminal Petition No.2969 of 2024 Order:
texts.facts: 3. The Food Inspector, S.S.Gutta, Mahabubnagar filed a complaint before the learned Magistrate against the petitioner herein and another for the offences punishable under Sections 16(1)(a) (1) read with Section 2(ia)(b) and Section 7(i) of the Prevention of Food and Adulteration Act, 1954 against the petitioner/accused No.1. 4. The allegations in the complaint, in brief, are that on 28.01.2006, the Food Inspector visited the shop of accused No.1 and found 2000 packets (each containing 50 gms of Agni brand tea dust manufactured by M/s Tata Tea Limited) in carton boxes along with other food items. The Food Inspector drew samples as per the procedure prescribed and sent the same to the Public Analyst for analysis. The Public Analyst in his report opined that the sample contains 172 ppm of iron filings which is against the prescribed stands and is thus adulterated. Later, the Food Inspector filed complaint before the learned Magistrate against the accused Nos.1 to 3 alleging offences as stated above.
texts.arguments: 6. The learned Assistant Public Prosecutor submits that as per the orders dated 02.11.2017 issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, the Commissioners of Food Safety of all the States were directed not to launch for non-conformance of limit of iron filings for cases where samples were picked up/tested prior to 19.05.2016 and were advised to withdraw all such prosecutions launched prior to 19.05.2016 either under FSS Act, 2006 or PFA Act, 1954.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 6. The learned Assistant Public Prosecutor submits that as per the orders dated 02.11.2017 issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, the Commissioners of Food Safety of all the States were directed not to launch for non-conformance of limit of iron filings for cases where samples were picked up/tested prior to 19.05.2016 and were advised to withdraw all such prosecutions launched prior to 19.05.2016 either under FSS Act, 2006 or PFA Act, 1954.
